mechanism: A definable ratio between two distinct {{value}} types or {{metric}}s at a specific point in time. It allows agents with orthogonal utility functions to transact.
invariants: Names the source and target {{value}} types and the ratio between them.
Carries the timestamp or window over which the rate is valid.
Invertible where there is no spread: Rate(A→B) equals 1 / Rate(B→A).

data_schema.description: A rate between two value types, valid over a stated window.

ratio.description: Units of target per unit of source.

valid_until.description: End of the validity window, if bounded.

failure_modes: Stale rate: the window has expired and the ratio is applied anyway.
Assumed invertibility: a spread is present and the inverse rate is computed rather than quoted.
